overlap.comparison: The general unique minimizing threshold theorem directly covers uniqueness and C¹ regularity once the threshold is proper. It leaves the exact optimum and curvature unevaluated.

For the proper positive-row optimizer it already gives local C² and an abstract Schur formula for the Hessian. The explicit blocks, sign cutoffs and exact noncentral calibration are additional calculations.

The accepted positive curvature result needs two strictly captured vertices with centroid coordinates at most 1/3. The calibration has both captured coordinates 7/18, so its negative-semidefinite Hessian falls outside that hypothesis.

readability: The early-threshold estimate applies only to positive-mass thresholds, which are at least a−η. The remaining compact interval has positive baseline CDF on a small enlargement. Inertia is basis-invariant, so the unnormalized split directions suffice.

summary: The unique threshold, smooth optimized capacity, three Hessian blocks, five inertias and exact calibration all follow for 0<a<b.
